generic_domain.justification: Neutrino physics is a more general and broader term compared to neutrino astronomy. Whereas neutrino astronomy focuses on the astronomical sources of neutrinos, neutrino physics encompasses the entire study of neutrinos, including their properties, interactions, behavior under various conditions, detection methods, theoretical models, and applications in both astrophysical contexts and other areas of physics. Therefore, neutrino physics can broadly cover topics that are relevant to neutrino astronomy as well.
